paper.hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 undergoes increased aggregation in the endo-lysosome compared with APOE3.

row.Finding description: Among neuronal LRP1-intact APP/PS1 mice at 9 months, APOE4 mice had more GDN-HCl-extractable insoluble hippocampal apoE than APOE3 mice, with 18–23 mice per group.
row.Finding quote: Insoluble apoE amounts in the GDN-HCl fraction were higher in APP/PS1; APOE4 control mice than in APP/PS1; APOE3 control mice, which was not affected by neuronal LRP1 deficit ( Figure 3I ).
row.Finding summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4; neuronal LRP1 intact) -> (higher insoluble hippocampal apoE)
row.Experimental system: Male and female 9-month-old APPswe/PSEN1ΔE9 mice with homozygous human APOE3-targeted replacement or APOE4-targeted replacement, Lrp1 floxed alleles, and no αCaMKII-Cre; hippocampal detergent-insoluble pellet extracted with guanidine hydrochloride and analyzed by protein-normalized apoE ELISA. Tissue insolubility was measured without cell-type or endolysosomal localization; these are amyloid-model mice, not non-aged human cells.

row.Finding description: In cultured cells expressing fluorescently tagged APOE, APOE4 accumulated in enlarged late endosomes and lysosomes relative to APOE3, providing an accumulation surrogate for aggregation.
row.Finding quote: Consistent with previous studies showing that expression of APOE4 damages lysosomal membrane integrity, dysregulates endo/lysosomal pH, and results in enlarged endosomes in various models, we found that APOE4 accumulates in enlarged lysosomes and late endosomes (Figure 1).
row.Finding summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased APOE accumulation in enlarged late endosomes and lysosomes)
row.Experimental system: Cultured cell lines expressing fluorescently tagged human APOE3 or APOE4; localization in late endosomes and lysosomes. Host species, cell type, source, age, treatment duration, and detailed localization assay are not specified. Human brain-cell identity and non-aged status are not established.

Figure 1 legend: 'Aberrant lysosomal trafficking of APOE4 (below, orange) vs. APOE3 (above, blue). APOE is trafficked to the lysosome from the post-Golgi compartment...' - a diagram.
